dimensions.name: Grid-connected applicability
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether the project is demonstrably a grid-connected renewable electricity activity suitable for ACM0002.

legacy_rubric.0: Project is not grid-connected renewable electricity or clearly mismatched.
legacy_rubric.1: Claimed as grid-connected but evidence is weak/indirect.
legacy_rubric.2: Generally aligned with ACM0002 scope with minor ambiguity.
legacy_rubric.3: Clearly grid-connected renewable project with direct documentary proof.

dimensions.name: Technology eligibility under ACM0002
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether project technology type is within ACM0002-applicable renewable categories and consistently represented across records.

legacy_rubric.0: Technology is out-of-scope or inconsistent with claimed method.
legacy_rubric.1: Technology claim exists but conflicts across documents.
legacy_rubric.2: Technology mostly consistent with minor inconsistencies.
legacy_rubric.3: Technology eligibility fully consistent across source documents.

dimensions.name: Baseline construction integrity
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether baseline is explicitly and auditablely constructed as displaced grid electricity.

legacy_rubric.2: Baseline construction mostly valid with minor gaps.
legacy_rubric.3: Baseline construction explicit, auditable, and fully traceable.

dimensions.name: Grid emission factor chain
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether EF source, parameterization, and tool link are complete and reproducible.

legacy_rubric.1: EF value exists but not reproducible.
legacy_rubric.2: EF chain mostly documented with limited missing links.
legacy_rubric.3: EF chain complete: source, tool reference, value, and reproducibility all clear.

dimensions.name: Generation/export metering quality
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether EG inputs are measured through calibrated and traceable metering and records.

legacy_rubric.1: Metering exists but major traceability defects.
legacy_rubric.2: Metering is usable with some documentation gaps.
legacy_rubric.3: Metering is calibrated, continuous, and fully traceable to source logs.

dimensions.name: Project emissions (PE) treatment
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether PE is correctly screened and quantified when required.

legacy_rubric.2: PE treatment mostly correct with minor omissions.
legacy_rubric.3: PE treatment complete and condition-consistent with clear traceability.

dimensions.name: Leakage (LE) treatment
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether leakage is explicitly justified or quantified consistent with ACM0002 conditions.

legacy_rubric.2: Leakage treatment mostly adequate with minor gaps.
legacy_rubric.3: Leakage fully justified/quantified with evidence chain.

dimensions.name: ER formula reproducibility
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether ER = BE − PE − LE is internally consistent and independently recalculable.

legacy_rubric.1: Formula present but major arithmetic/data inconsistencies.
legacy_rubric.2: Recalculation broadly matches with limited discrepancy.
legacy_rubric.3: Recalculation closely matches with full parameter traceability.

dimensions.name: Additionality robustness
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether additionality argument is structured and defensible against challenge.

legacy_rubric.2: Structured additionality argument with unresolved weak points.
legacy_rubric.3: Strong, tool-consistent additionality defense with full evidence support.

dimensions.name: Monitoring architecture completeness
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether monitoring parameters, frequency, QA/QC, and continuity controls are complete and operational.

legacy_rubric.1: Monitoring framework exists but serious operational gaps.
legacy_rubric.2: Monitoring framework mostly operational with minor weaknesses.
legacy_rubric.3: Monitoring architecture complete, repeatable, and audit-ready.

dimensions.name: Verification reproducibility and cycle consistency
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether validation/verification findings are reproducible across cycles and independent reviewers.

legacy_rubric.2: Verification mostly consistent with limited cross-cycle gaps.
legacy_rubric.3: Validation/verification evidence is consistent and reproducible across cycles.

dimensions.name: Registry/version transition readiness
dimensions.legacy_definition: Whether project can remain operable under registry packaging and methodology/version changes.

legacy_rubric.1: Basic handling with major documentation gaps.
legacy_rubric.3: Stable registry/version handling with clear transition evidence.
